metadata.description: The repository checks' suites whose behaviour is the host's own: the installers that download a tool for this platform, the runner's temporary drive, the Windows-target lint's cross compiler, the subprocess runner's PATH resolution, the worker share read off this host's processors and memory, the platform dispatch's per-family steps, and the tree lock each platform takes through its own kernel interface. Nested in repo-checks, whose helpers and fixtures it imports, so that project runs once while this one runs on every platform.

typecheck.command: uv run -q ty check tools/repo-checks/tests/host && uv run -q ty check --python-platform win32 tools/repo-checks/tests/host

test.command: uv run -q coverage run -m pytest tools/repo-checks/tests/host
